adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding plates (Diyo) or supporting the Kalash
movement_profile.footwork: Slow, rhythmic steps following a circular path
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular formation in courtyards or temples
movement_profile.posture: Erect and steady to support head-loading

signature_moves.description: Moving while keeping a copper water vessel steady on the crown of the head.
signature_moves.name: Kalash Balancing

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Sudden head movements or jerky steps that would displace the balanced ritual objects.

music_profile.sound_description: A purely vocal performance where a group of women sing in unison or call-and-response patterns. The sound is characterized by the absence of drums or melodic instruments, relying on the natural resonance of the singers' voices in an outdoor setting.
music_profile.vocal_style: Group singing by the dancers themselves

basic_steps: Maintain an upright posture to balance a vessel on the head
Step in a slow, rhythmic circular path
Coordinate hand movements while holding a ritual plate
Sing the Sangini melody in unison with the group
teaching.level_notes: Requires high level of balance and vocal coordination.
